subject: Urgent: Olivia Park — competing offer, quick decision window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Olivia Park — competing offer and deadline (please advise)

Team — forwarding Olivia's note below. Summary: she received a competing offer from CloudScale (internal recruiter Sarah Kim copied below) with an RTO of $230k base, 0.6% equity, starts in 3 weeks. Olivia is asking if we can respond with a bridge by EOD Friday to keep her in the process. Current approved band for L5 Eng is $190k–210k base; hiring manager (Laura) and I discussed sign-on and band stretch.

Asking: can we (1) approve a short window bridge offer (one-time sign-on + modest base uplift) or (2) escalate for band exception to match the number? Finance/legal turnaround will be the gating item.

Attachment: competing_offer.pdf (PDF, 48KB) — candidate attached competitor offer.

Karthik
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

-------- Forwarded message --------
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Offer update — need decision window
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the great conversation earlier. I wanted to share that I received an official offer from CloudScale this morning and they gave me a tight decision window (they want an answer by Friday EOD). Key terms: $230,000 base, 0.6% equity (standard 4‑year, 1yr cliff), 10k sign-on stretched over first payroll. I really prefer the role at Redwood — the product and team are the draw — but the total comp is a meaningful uplift vs my current package.

If Redwood can come closer on base (even a bridge at $220k) and a reasonable sign-on, I can stay in process and delay responding to CloudScale. Otherwise I may have to accept for timing reasons. I understand bands exist — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Olivia Park
Senior Software Engineer
Nimbus Analytics (current)
olivia.park@gmail.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Olivia Park — competing offer and deadline (please advise)

Thanks for the heads up, Karthik. I read Olivia's note and the attached competitor offer. She's strong — match to L5/L6 skill set and team fit seems excellent. Quick thoughts: we have two levers that move quickly — sign-on and start-date bonuses (manager discretionary) and an immediate base uplift within band if we can stretch to top of L5. Matching to $230k base will require a band exception (L6) and VP sign-off.

Proposed pragmatic bridge to keep her: 
- Base: $220,000 (band-stretch to top of L5, needs hiring mgr + people ops sign-off)
- Equity: 0.5% 4y
- One-time sign-on: $15,000 (payable on day 30)
- Offer expiry: 7 calendar days

If Laura confirms she can approve the sign-on and top-of-band push, I'll ask People Ops + Finance for expedited approval. If we need anything beyond the sign-on above, we should loop Jonas.

Can you draft a bridged offer letter today if Laura says yes? I'll ping Legal for a quick review.

Marcus
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Olivia Park — competing offer and deadline (please advise)

Thanks — I reviewed Olivia's profile and the CloudScale terms. I can commit manager discretionary funds for a sign-on up to $12,000 to keep her in process. I can also push to the top of L5 ($210k) immediately. Beyond that (e.g., $220k base) requires a band exception and VP approval.

If Marcus can accept $210k + $12k sign-on + 0.5% eq, we should send a firm bridge offer with 7-day expiry and clarify start-date flexibility. If Karthik thinks she will still choose CloudScale at that level, we should escalate to Jonas now.

Laura
Director, Engineering | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Olivia Park — competing offer and deadline (please advise)

Appreciate the quick context. I'm prepared to approve a one-time band exception for this candidate given the speed and quality signals — but we should be explicit about limits to stay precedent-conscious. Approvals: 
- Temporary bridge base: authorize up to $220,000 (one-time bridge, not a permanent re-band without business case)
- Sign-on: up to $18,000 one-time
- Equity: 0.5%

Conditions: 
1) We document rationale in the req (candidate market, competing offer) — I will add note to HR ticket.
2) Legal reviews the offer letter before send.
3) Offer flagged as "bridge exception" for internal compensation reporting.

I'll ask People Ops to mark HR-REQ-7432 as approved for the exception. Marcus/Karthik — please send final numbers and copy me in the offer email.

Jonas
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

(Attachment: approval_notes.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Redwood Inference — Senior Software Engineer (bridge offer)

Hi Olivia — really appreciate your transparency and patience. We discussed internally and would like to extend a bridge offer to keep you in process. This is time-sensitive and aimed to match your decision window. Key terms (bridge exception approved):

- Base salary: $220,000 per year
- Equity: 0.5% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- One-time sign-on: $18,000 (paid on first full payroll)
- Target team: Core Inference Platform (Marcus Lin)
- Start window: flexible within 2–4 weeks; we can adjust if you need more time
- Offer expiry: 7 calendar days from receipt

Attached: offer_letter_v2.pdf (PDF, 62KB) — draft pending Legal review. Please let me know timing constraints; if you can give us until Friday COB for an answer to CloudScale, that would be ideal. If you want any changes, tell us now and we'll try to accommodate within the exception parameters.

Thanks — looking forward to your response.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
